# vendor/

`netzlabor-pi-durable-postgres-0.2.0.tgz`: `@netzlabor/pi-durable-postgres` built with `pnpm pack` from a clean
clone of the local repo `../pi-durable-postgres` at tag `v0.2.0-pi-durable-1.5.2` (commit `b43fe16`, Pi Durable 1.5.2).
A git+file dependency needs the adapter's build scripts to run at install time (dist is not committed) and an absolute
local path, so the packed tarball is checked in instead. Replace it when the adapter's upstream PR lands.
